Strength +13: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Physical Sheltering +34: +34 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Fortification +145%: +145% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Raging Inferno: Your True Rage effects (such as Barbarian or Bestial Rage) light you on fire, as if you were under the effects of a Fire Shield. This ability also protects you from Energy Drain for the duration.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
